name: HnswStore::delete / reopen / concurrent access

test_list.description: Deleting an id removes that row from the current table and scope without affecting another partition.
Removing the persisted HNSW cache file does not lose rows and reopening reconstructs searchable results from SQLite.
A truncated or invalid HNSW artifact is discarded and rebuilt from committed SQLite vectors.
A failed SQLite commit leaves the last committed data searchable and does not publish an index generation.
Shared-handle concurrent readers and writers return valid results and preserve every committed row.

inputs.name: ids
inputs.description: Chunk identities to delete from the handle's fixed table and scope.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: Persistent store directory reused after closing the handle or simulating a missing/corrupt index cache.

output_description: Transactional deletion count with SQLite as durable authority and an atomically published HNSW cache.
